payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure that paths were not shared between the training and test sets, including filtering queries and excluding hyponyms that appeared in the training set.

claims.text: None of the queries (synsets) are shared between the training and evaluation (validation/test) sets, ensuring distinct paths.
Queries observed during path training were eliminated from the validation and test sets to ensure all evaluated queries are new.
Hyponyms that appear in the training set were excluded from the test and validation sets to prevent models from copying.
